question: What division does the speaker seek to know fully and without limit?
premises: The speaker expresses a desire to know something fully.
The object of knowledge is a division.
This division consists of eight groups of eight.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully the division of the eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight groups of eight is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight groups of eight.
